subject: sponge traveler
art_direction: 多孔海绵变成方圆旅行客，角落系小布包，青绿鼻尖与橘黄色身体，神情认真。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Design a small traveler whose body is a thick yellow cleaning sponge, with rounded corners and uneven real foam pores. A tiny teal nose and a serious mouth sit on one broad face. It carries a small tied cloth bundle over one shoulder, leaning forward on two short felt legs as if ready to leave. Keep the bundle close to the body for a compact silhouette. Use a pale blue background, warm foam highlights, and subdued textile detail. Avoid household cleaning scenes, water, grime, or existing mascot likenesses. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
